{{Quote|In ''that case,'' you want my ''automatic'' units! Just put them on... ''they do the rest''!|Kitak Hu|<ref name="world" />}}
'''Kitak Hu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Paigun]] who ran [[Hu's Emporium]], a weapons store marketed towards [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on the crime-ridden "Gambler's World" of [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]]. Hu specialized in designing and selling harnesses outfitted with automatic weapons, which could make even droids not designed for combat into deadly forces. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Hu attempted to sell a pair of these harnesses to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], only for their weapons to activate on their own and damage his store.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I must say... you don't look like the usual destruction droids!|Kitak Hu, to C-3PO and R2-D2|<ref name="world" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Paigun]], Kitak Hu was the owner and proprietor of a store called [[Hu's Emporium]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]], specializing in selling weapon harnesses for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were often the target of gangs and rogue [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] on the "Gambler's World." Located in the dimly lit depths of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Efavan/Legends|Efavan]], Hu's Emporium sold a wide variety of defensive weapons for droids, ranging from small locators to harnesses loaded with automatic weapons, [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenades]], [[Sonic stunner/Legends|sonic charges]],<ref name="geonosis" /> and even a device that purported to read "evil intent" at 50 paces.<ref name="world" /> Hu was also an inventor himself, using his shop as a laboratory and testing ground for many of his latest creations.<ref name="geonosis" />

[[File:HuThreepio.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Kitak Hu outfits C-3PO with some of his automatic weapons.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Hu's shop was visited by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], a pair of droids looking to help protect their owner, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who had come under target by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As neither of his prospective customers were designed to handle weapons, Hu recommended a pair of his harnesses outfitted with the latest of his automatic creations. Hu put the devices on the droids himself, but the harnesses proved bulky and difficult to maneuver in, causing R2-D2 and C-3PO to fall down as they tried to make their way to the testing area. The impact with the floor caused the automatic weapons to go off, much to Hu's surprise, as they were only designed to activate when the wearers were under attack. The weapons' activation caused significant damage to Hu's store before they eventually shut off on their own. However, despite the harrowing experience, C-3PO and R2-D2 still purchased a pair of locators from Hu before they went on their way.<ref name="world" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I-I don't understand it, sir! Your units should come on only when you are being attacked!|Kitak Hu|<ref name="world" />}}
Catering his business to droids that were vulnerable to theft on the crime-ridden "Gambler's World," Hu had a less-than-trustworthy reputation, as he was known to exaggerate the effectiveness of the devices he sold.<ref name="geonosis" /> Hu was very confident in his weapons' capabilities and safety for its users, and was considerably surprised in 1 ABY when some of his devices went off on their own, damaging his store.<ref name="world" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kitak Hu made his first and only appearance in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in ''[[Gambler's World]]'', a [[Star Wars (comic strip)|comic strip]] story arc written and illustrated by [[Russ Manning]] and released in [[1979]].<ref name="world" />
